description: SHA256 checksums for results directory (v10 audit phase 5). All result-data code replaced with reproducible training methods. No hardcoded metrics. Evaluation pipeline (test->evaluate->aggregate) fully connected.

metadata.notes: Pre-computed experimental result CSV files have been removed. They are replaced by results/reproduce_experiments.py, which provides training commands to reproduce all paper experiments. configuration_reuse_map.json now maps experiment IDs to config files and training commands only -- no expected metric values. Structural metadata files (scene_sensor_slice_map.json, ssdd_scene_split_8160.csv, SSDD_annotation_version_note.txt) are retained as they contain no experimental results. audit_scene_provenance.py added for C6 scene provenance verification.
